errors.evidence: The x-axis is not labeled. It displays years as tick labels, but there is no axis title 'Jahren'.
The green line starts at a value below 3% in 1970, approximately at 2.9%. 3.3% is a significant overestimation.

errors.text_span: bis zu etwa 1,3 % im Jahr 2010 sinkt
errors.evidence: The line reaches its minimum value of approximately 1.3% around the year 2015, not in 2010. In 2010, the value is higher, at about 1.4-1.5%.
The value in 2020 is closer to 1.7%. 1.8% is a slight overestimation.

errors.text_span: eine gestrichelte schwarze Linie, die bei etwa 2,1 % im Jahr 1970 beginnt und bis zum Jahr 2020 auf etwa 2,1 % bleibt
errors.evidence: This misinterprets the dashed line. It is a static, horizontal reference line at the 2% level, not a data series that begins in 1970 and ends in 2020.
The dashed reference line is located exactly at the 2% mark on the y-axis, not at approximately 2.1%.
